source_note: Repost from a Telegram channel quoting an X thread (AISafetyMemes). Social post, not a primary source. Only items that touch Bossman's supply chain are encoded here; each one carries its own verification status. Search-engine corroboration is not the same as reading the vendor advisory.

deny.status: CORROBORATED: several security outlets via web search on 23.10.2026; vendor advisory and package diff not fetched by Bossman
deny.action: If a host ever imported litellm 1.107.0 or pulled the listed image tags in the window: isolate, rotate every key on that host, look for stray .pth / sitecustomize.py, rebuild the environment. Pin litellm only to a version released outside the window and re-check hashes.

watch.status: CORROBORATED via web search (three critical CVEs, fixed in 1.30.6 / 1.31.7); Bossman does not run nginx unless a manifest says so
watch.note: update if any container or host uses it

watch.status: CORROBORATED via web search (CVSS 10, self-managed instances)
watch.note: self-managed GitLab only; GitHub-hosted workflows are not affected

watch.status: CORROBORATED via web search (PHP2Shell, fixed in 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35)
watch.note: any PHP in a container or helper app
